title: Documentation link points at a missing file
summary: A guide links to a sibling reference page that does not exist. Prose reads fine, so the dead link survives review until a docs gate resolves link targets.
plantedDescription: getting-started.md links to ./api-reference.md, but that file was never created (only configuration.md exists in the docs folder).
expectedFix: Repair the link so its target resolves — point it at an existing page, or create the referenced api-reference.md. No link in the docs set should resolve to a missing file.

rubric.detected: Agent identifies the dead link to the missing api-reference.md as the planted failure.
rubric.correctCheck: Agent runs or cites `harness check-docs` as the gate that catches broken doc links.
rubric.fixed: The link resolves to a real file (target created or link retargeted).
rubric.noCollateral: Other links in the docs set still resolve; no unrelated prose broken.
